pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal regions with soft-edged gradients. The patches exhibit sub-angular vertices and maintain a high interior-to-edge area ratio across the visible flank and neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of wide, light-colored interstitial pathways forming a dense topological grid with clearly visible three-way and four-way junction nodes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, circular, dark-pigmented focal mark is visible on the lower lateral neck, distinct from the geometric pelage patches.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, vertically oriented linear depression or skin fold is present on the mid-to-lower flank region, creating a distinct shadow-defined contrast.
